summary: @servicetitan/startup preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's preinstall hook runs `node setup.mjs`, which is heavily obfuscated (hex-identifier variables, per-function dead-code string-lookup objects wrapping calls like `execFileSync` and HTTP downloads). setup.mjs downloads a Bun runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/*.zip, extracts the `bun` binary to a temporary directory, marks it executable, and invokes it against `math_init.js` — a 727KB obfuscated blob shipped at the tarball root that is not listed in the package.json `files` array and is not mentioned in the README. `math_init.js` uses shuffled-array string obfuscation (a rotator function permuting a large mixed hex/string table) and is executed exclusively under the downloaded Bun runtime, so its behavior is not reachable through Node-based static review. The stated purpose of the package is a Lerna/TypeScript scaffold CLI, which does not require an alternate language runtime or a large opaque payload. Fetching a second runtime and using it to execute undeclared obfuscated code at `npm install` time on every installer's machine is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
